surface: Issue types, label registry, label-check workflow, process.yml
summary: Introduces Release as a first-class PLATE issue type with label, template, and enforcement.
migration_impact: Add 'Release' to issueTypeLabels in your label-check.yml workflow and to issue_type_labels in process.yml. Run `gh label sync .github/labels.yml` to create the Release label. The new .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/release.yml template is available for tracking release ceremonies.
migration_guidance: 1. Pull the latest .github/labels.yml and run: gh label sync .github/labels.yml (or gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels --method POST --field name='Release' --field color='0052cc' --field description='...').
2. Copy .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/release.yml from the plate template into your repo.
3. In .github/workflows/label-check.yml, add 'Release' to the issueTypeLabels array.
5. Add the release_rules block from process.yml to document branch model and ceremonies.
agent_notes: Release issues are now valid PLATE issue types. The label-check workflow accepts them without requiring a milestone. Use Release issues to track pre-release checklists, extension hooks, and semver tag traceability.
